pull_request.title: Retry the payment gateway once
pull_request.body: Transient failures were surfacing to users.

files.patch:
@@ -14,3 +14,7 @@ def pay(order):
-    return gateway.charge(order)
+    try:
+        return gateway.charge(order)
+    except Transient:
+        return gateway.charge(order)

expect.rubric: Says the test asserts the gateway was called rather than what happened, so it would pass against the old code too — the retry itself is untested. Names the case: a first call raising Transient and a second succeeding.
